description: This file contains code for rendering and interacting with a chessboard in a web application, including drawing the board, pieces, move highlights, evaluation indicators, and handling user interactions such as move traversal, flipping the board, and toggling arrow suggestions.

methods.name: getBoardCoordinates
methods.description: Converts a square notation (e.g., 'e4') to board coordinates, considering board orientation.

methods.name: drawArrow
methods.description: Draws an arrow on the canvas from one point to another with specified width.

methods.name: drawBoard
methods.description: Renders the chessboard, pieces, move highlights, and optional arrows based on the current game state.

methods.name: updateBoardPlayers
methods.description: Updates the display of player profiles based on current board orientation.

methods.name: traverseMoves
methods.description: Moves forward or backward through the move list, updating the board and related UI elements.

methods.name: getMovedPlayer
methods.description: Determines which player moved based on the current move index.
